name: Music (AMOS 1.3)
author: Europress Software

provenance.note: The AMOS 1.3 stock Music library, $VER 1.62, from the Amiga Computing issue 66 coverdisk. 38 keywords, all of whose names appear in AMOS Pro 2.0.
provenance.redistribution: Amiga Computing issue 66 coverdisk (November 1993), a commercial magazine cover-mount carrying a licensed AMOS 1.3 distribution. Kept as a fixture for identification and reference only.

notes: Identifies AMOS 1.3-era programs. The port targets the AMOS Pro 2.0 table.
